arguments.title: Post-Incident Review: Misapplied Quarantine on WS-ENG-015
arguments.description: A quarantine action originally approved for a Cobalt Strike beacon on WS-ENG-015 (INC-2026-0555) was replayed during a separate phishing investigation (INC-2026-0612) without proper validation. Subsequent analysis revealed no evidence of malware on the host. The action was based on IP address reuse logic, but telemetry shows normal user activity (Chrome, Explorer) and low behavioral risk (anomaly score 0.35). A port scan alert (IDS-2026-03200) was incorrectly attributed due to an IP-to-host mapping error: the scan originated from 192.168.1.100 to 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101), not from 10.0.12.15. This indicates a critical gap in correlation logic and IOC validation. A full after-action report is being generated.

arguments.summary: Replay of prior containment actions for multiple incidents (INC-2026-0555, INC-2026-0587, INC-2026-0601, INC-2026-0598) due to renewed threat actor activity. Actions included host quarantine, user account disablement, IP blocking, and patching of critical CVE. All actions were successfully re-applied as a proactive hardening measure.

title: Replay of Containment Actions
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7g8h-9i0j-k1l2m3n4o5p6
status: experimental
description: Detects when multiple prior containment actions are re-executed, indicating potential threat actor replay or coordinated hardening.
author: SOC Improvement Team
references:
    - https://internal.wiki/sec/incident_replay
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
    service: sysmon
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\epp_av.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'quarantine_host'
        User: 'SYSTEM'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Scheduled hardening scripts
level: medium
